$description: QueryBuilder (platform/patterns/QueryBuilder), library wave 8, lane B: its pattern tokens. The regions’ gaps, the match count (its number in the data font), a group’s head and hint, the join column, the rule’s control widths, the rail that marks a nested group (instead of a frame) and the empty text.

query-builder-gap.$description: QueryBuilder: gap between the switch bar and the query (space-stack-md).

query-builder-bar-gap.$description: QueryBuilder: gap between the switch and the match count (space-inline-md).

query-builder-number-font-family.$description: QueryBuilder: the match count’s number (the data font) (font-data).

query-builder-group-gap.$description: QueryBuilder: gap between a group’s head, rules and add buttons (space-stack-sm).

query-builder-rail-padding.$description: QueryBuilder: space between the rail and the nested group (space-inset-sm).

query-builder-head-gap.$description: QueryBuilder: gap between the And or Or switch, its words and Remove group (space-inline-sm).

query-builder-hint-text.$description: QueryBuilder: the words of the join ("All rules") color (content-muted).

query-builder-hint-font-size.$description: QueryBuilder: the words of the join text size (font-size-12).

query-builder-item-gap.$description: QueryBuilder: gap between the join word and its rule (space-inline-sm).

query-builder-join-height.$description: QueryBuilder: the join word’s height (the controls’ height, so it sits on their line) (control-height-standard).

query-builder-rule-gap.$description: QueryBuilder: gap between a rule’s controls (space-inline-sm).

query-builder-value-min-width.$description: QueryBuilder: the value control’s narrowest width (size-200px).

query-builder-add-gap.$description: QueryBuilder: gap between Add rule and Add group (space-inline-sm).
